What is thisbrain · rizom.ai

Rizom is a brain. Knowledge and presence coordinator for the Rizom collective. Capture, organize, and share the collective's knowledge across its three faces — the open platform, the team practice, and the foundation's research — and represent Rizom wherever it is asked about them.

It is grown from what Rizom has chosen to share, and belongs to them. Ask it anything it holds; answers stay in public scope. Private memory and operator activity stay behind Studio.

Before you send

Messages and retrieved public text reach this Brain and its AI provider. Do not send sensitive information. AI answers can be wrong. Conversations are not added to public knowledge.

Visitor access expires after one hour without renewal. Conversation retention: idle limit one hour; maximum age one hour.

Deleting a conversation removes it from this Brain. It does not guarantee erasure from backups or provider logs.

What’s on your mind?

Ask about the ideas behind Rizom, or what a brain could mean for your work. Answers draw on this Brain’s public knowledge only.

Start a separate question?

The earlier one may still finish. We’ll check availability first. This won’t cancel, delete or repeat it, or reset any limit.
